reviewer.agent: Claude Code (file handoff; environment names the handoff channel)

themes.label: AI listed among global challenges
themes.definition: AI is named only briefly in a catalogue of global challenges (war, hunger, climate, democracy at risk) without further discussion.
themes.inclusion: Include passages where AI appears as one item in a list of crises or challenges facing the world.
themes.exclusion: Exclude passages that elaborate AI risks, governance, or uses.
themes.boundary_cases: A list item that itself pairs promise and risk (e.g. 'promises and significant risks') stays a list mention but may also be coded AI_OPPORTUNITY_RISK_DUALITY.

examples.quote: a climate crisis, democracy at risk, strains within our societies, the promises and significant risks of artificial intelligence (AI). The list goes on.

themes.label: Promises and significant risks of AI
themes.definition: AI is characterized in a single phrase as carrying both promise and significant risk.
themes.inclusion: Include explicit phrasing that pairs AI's promise with its risks, even when brief.
themes.exclusion: Exclude lists that mention AI only as a threat.
themes.boundary_cases: When the duality appears only as a list item, code alongside AI_THREAT_LIST_MENTION.

examples.quote: the promises and significant risks of artificial intelligence (AI)

value.rationale: The single US 2024 passage mentions AI only in passing within a list of global challenges, characterizing it briefly as both promising and risky; the passage's focus is on hope and past achievements.
